import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { runInNewContext } from "node:vm";
import { readFile, mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
const supplied = process.argv[2]
  ? JSON.parse(await readFile(process.argv[2], "utf8"))
  : null;
const root = resolve(
  "docs/research/prose-qr/styled-story-2026-10-11/" +
    (supplied?.id || "diagnostic-01"),
);
await mkdir(root);
const specs = supplied?.inputs || ["ornament-02", "ornament-08", "ornament-12"];
const bundle = await readFile(
  createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve("jsqr"),
  "utf8",
);
const sha = (b) => createHash("sha256").update(b).digest("hex");
const source = await readFile(new URL("diagnose.mjs", import.meta.url));
await writeFile(resolve(root, "source.mjs.txt"), source, { flag: "wx" });
await writeFile(
  resolve(root, "manifest.json"),
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      specs,
      binarizerCalls: specs.length,
      locatorCalls: specs.length,
      decoderCalls: 0,
      bundleSha256: sha(bundle),
      sourceSha256: sha(source),
      classification:
        "Source-aligned diagnostic after ordinary failures; no transformed reader input or supplied locator geometry",
    },
    null,
    2,
  ),
  { flag: "wx" },
);
const context = {
  module: { exports: {} },
  exports: {},
  Uint8ClampedArray,
  Uint8Array,
  Int32Array,
  Float64Array,
};
const needle = "return __webpack_require__(__webpack_require__.s = 3);";
if (!bundle.includes(needle)) throw Error("Bundle entry changed");
runInNewContext(
  bundle.replace(needle, "globalThis.internals=__webpack_require__; " + needle),
  context,
);
const binarize = context.internals(4).binarize;
const locate = context.internals(12).locate;
const results = [];
for (const id of specs) {
  const base = resolve(root, "../" + (supplied?.batch || "batch-03"), id);
  const png = await readFile(base + ".png");
  const layout = JSON.parse(await readFile(base + "-layout.json", "utf8"));
  const width = png.readUInt32BE(16),
    height = png.readUInt32BE(20);
  const rgba = execFileSync(
    "python3",
    [
      "-B",
      "-c",
      "import cv2,sys;a=cv2.imread(sys.argv[1]);sys.stdout.buffer.write(cv2.cvtColor(a,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGBA).tobytes())",
      base + ".png",
    ],
    { maxBuffer: 80000000 },
  );
  const { binarized } = binarize(
    new Uint8ClampedArray(rgba),
    width,
    height,
    false,
  );
  const locations = locate(binarized);
  const cells = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < layout.modules; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < layout.modules; x++) {
      const px = Math.floor(
          (layout.spec.quiet + x + 0.5) * layout.unit + (supplied?.offset || 0),
        ),
        py = Math.floor(
          (layout.spec.quiet + y + 0.5) * layout.unit + (supplied?.offset || 0),
        );
      cells.push({
        x,
        y,
        px,
        py,
        expected: layout.matrix[y][x],
        observed: !!binarized.get(px, py),
        rgb: rgba[4 * (py * width + px)],
      });
    }
  const row = {
    id,
    pngSha256: sha(png),
    locations,
    cells,
    wrong: cells.filter((c) => c.expected !== c.observed).length,
    expectedDark: cells.filter((c) => c.expected).length,
    wrongDark: cells.filter((c) => c.expected && !c.observed).length,
    wrongLight: cells.filter((c) => !c.expected && c.observed).length,
  };
  results.push(row);
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify({
      id,
      locations,
      wrong: row.wrong,
      wrongDark: row.wrongDark,
      wrongLight: row.wrongLight,
    }),
  );
}
await writeFile(
  resolve(root, "results.json"),
  JSON.stringify(results, null, 2),
  { flag: "wx" },
);
